messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: prod-inference-high-5xx - sudden increase in 5xx (avg 4.2% last 5m, baseline 0.1%). Affected models: rdx-v1-*, region: us-west-2. KV cache miss rate up ~8x. Routing fallback to smaller variants detected. @sam you are oncall.

sam: Ack. joining. pulling logs now. can someone paste recent deploys?

jia: I see a quantized model rollout started ~35m ago: deploy/rdx-v1-q2 -> live w/ canary 30%. CPU/GPU metrics show higher kernel time.

arun: That matches what I flagged in the morning - q2 had an untested kernel path for cropping attention. possible degradation in KV cache compatibility.

kelly: Customer-impact check: noticed spike in error reports from enterprise customers (cust: AcmeCorp) — some 500s on generate endpoints, ~12 affected API keys. SLA alerts fired.

mike: Confirmed. Support queue has 7 threads referencing "inference failed" in last 20m. We've flagged a potential P0 if errors persist.

sam: Mitigation plan: 1) rollback q2 canary to 0% 2) force compatible model variant for routes to rdx-v1-compat 3) increase KV cache TTL to reduce cold misses. Doing step 1 now.

jia: Rolling back canary: `deployctl rollout cancel deploy/rdx-v1-q2 --canary`

incident-bot: automation: rollback job started (job_id: 0x9f3b). Estimated completion ~2m.

sam: rollback completed. observing metrics... 5xx dropping to 1.0% -> 0.3% over next 4m. KV miss still elevated but trending down.

arun: Good. Root cause hypothesis: q2 introduced a quantized attention kernel that invalidated a cache key shape assumption, causing higher miss storms and slow fallback paths.

kelly: Next steps: schedule postmortem, capture timeline, customer impact, and remediation items. I can book a 60m postmortem slot tomorrow 10:00 PT unless objections.

nora: I'll own KV cache action items and follow-up tuning: audit key-shape invariants, add unit test for cache key gen, and ship a canary with safety check. ETA: 2 sprints for full guardrail; I'll propose immediate short-term patch within 48h.

arun: I'll own model rollout gating: add a preflight that verifies cache key compatibility and perf regression check for new quant kernels. PR and automation task created.

mike: Support -> I'll draft customer comms for affected customers and hand to success for outreach. Posting draft to #support-drafts in a few mins.

kelly: Created incident ticket INC-2026-341 (link: https://redsoc.atlassian/incidents/INC-2026-341) with initial timeline and owners. Added required reducers: postmortem owner=kelly, technical lead=arun, runtime owner=jia, kv owner=nora.

sam: Thanks. For postmortem prep: please paste key logs, deploy hashes, and the perf graphs to the ticket. We'll do RCA + follow-ups in the meeting.

incident-bot: Reminder: paging window for this incident closed. No ongoing customer-facing impact.

kelly: Postmortem scheduled. Agenda: timeline, customer impact, root cause, action items, timeline/owners. Nora/arun/jia/sam to present.

nora: Noting action items in the ticket now: KV-1 (short patch 48h), KV-2 (unit tests), KV-3 (monitoring alert for miss storms).

arun: I'll attach a short checklist for quant rollouts and add the automation PR link in the ticket.

sam: Closing loop here — thanks everyone for quick response. I'll follow up in the postmortem with any remaining telemetry. :thumbsup:
